questions.question: What is Java?
questions.ideal_answer: Java is an object-oriented programming language.

questions.question: What is JVM?
questions.ideal_answer: Java Virtual Machine executes Java bytecode.

questions.question: JDK vs JRE?
questions.ideal_answer: JDK includes development tools, JRE runs applications.

questions.question: What is OOP?
questions.ideal_answer: Object-oriented programming using classes and objects.

questions.question: What is Inheritance?
questions.ideal_answer: One class acquiring properties from another.

questions.question: What is Encapsulation?
questions.ideal_answer: Hiding internal details using access modifiers.

questions.question: What is Spring Boot?
questions.ideal_answer: Framework for creating Java applications quickly.

questions.question: Collections Framework?
questions.ideal_answer: Provides List, Set, Map and Queue structures.

questions.question: Design Scalable Java App.
questions.ideal_answer: Use microservices, caching and load balancing.
